objective: 在Phase50六模型pure-PD消息直方图fresh-blind闭环后，使用SGLang生产MooncakeTransferEngine的RDMA batch-transfer原语，实测六模型P1-D1逻辑KV chunk在L1/L2/L3上的连续物理通信代价曲线库
execution_model: external pre-measurement topology inventory; 36 auditable two-rank GPU measurement shards; deterministic CPU aggregation into 18 model-conditioned physical curves

research_scope.scheduler_decision_scope: none in Phase51; Phase52 may compare communication-only placement

topology_definitions.L1: one host, two distinct GPUs; Mooncake protocol remains RDMA and forced TCP/MNNVL/intranode-NVLink paths remain disabled
topology_definitions.L2: two distinct hosts in the same rack and network domain, one GPU endpoint per host
topology_definitions.L3: two distinct hosts in different racks but the same declared RDMA fabric/network domain, one GPU endpoint per host

topology_classification_policy: host/rack/fabric identity and endpoint membership must be frozen before the first transfer record; labels may not be inferred from measured latency, bandwidth or benchmark output

transport_contract.direction_policy: measure rank0_to_rank1 and rank1_to_rank0; per-replica knot uses the slower direction
transport_contract.descriptor_policy: match MooncakeKVManager._send_kvcache_generic for contiguous P1-D1 page indices: MHA/GQA uses 2*num_layers K/V descriptors; MLA uses num_layers descriptors; one batch_transfer_sync call per logical chunk

model_layout_contract.source: Phase48 six-model structure contract backed by Phase40/41 Qwen and Phase47 five-model GPU teacher validation
model_layout_contract.grid_rule: retain page counts <= 4096/page_size_tokens; payload_bytes = page_count * kv_bytes_per_page

measurement_contract.clock: sender-side time.perf_counter_ns around synchronous production batch_transfer_sync; CUDA synchronized before and after the timed call
measurement_contract.data_validation: outside timed intervals, verify every byte in the transferred payload on the receiver GPU for both directions and every payload knot
measurement_contract.curve_replica_policy: median across repeats per direction; maximum across directions; then maximum across two frozen placement replicas; never select the faster direction or replica
measurement_contract.interpolation: piecewise linear over log2(payload_bytes) using unsmoothed physical knots; no extrapolation claim outside each model's measured payload support
measurement_contract.raw_storage: all per-iteration records remain in Git-external JSONL; Git stores only compact knots, audits, hashes and variance diagnostics

container_contract.required_gpu_class: CUDA GPU with GPUDirect RDMA; B200 environment already proven by Phase40/47 is acceptable

claim_boundary: Phase51 establishes physical Mooncake/RDMA communication curves only for the frozen endpoint placements, six descriptor layouts and measured payload support
Phase51 does not evaluate H0/H0+DNN cost accuracy or placement; Phase52 will perform deterministic convolution without retraining
L1/L2/L3 labels are topology metadata, not speed classes; measured ordering is allowed to differ
the frozen curves assume each logical chunk maps to one contiguous page-index run per layer; arbitrary physical page fragmentation is not claimed
the curves exclude model compute, memory feasibility, queueing, resource availability, congestion from other jobs, bootstrap/control metadata and communication-compute overlap
stop_and_block_if: the topology plan is not frozen before raw measurement or derives topology labels from speed
any of six model x three topology x two replica measurements is unavailable
the production MooncakeTransferEngine batch transfer, RDMA or dma-buf registration is unavailable
execution falls back to TCP, MNNVL, intranode NVLink transport, staging or a custom memory pool
raw samples would enter Git or any existing protected raw/model/cache/PID asset would be touched
pinned inputs/source, W51 ancestry, model descriptors, payload grid, direction policy or minimum repeats differ
running requires model weights, inference, training, a checkpoint, Phase50 prediction recomputation or Phase52 placement analysis
